verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a client/server UI rendering library. It has no hosted environments or production data of its own, so offering a sandbox environment separate from production is a category error for this kind of product. The landing-page code playground is a code-editing demo, not an isolated test environment against production data, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
